description: A bounded decision assessment: proceed, revise, or pause. Supply decision (or proposed_action) and goal. More relevant context supports better guidance: include the evidence for and against, alternatives considered, earlier decisions or rules that bear on the choice, constraints, affected people, reversibility, urgency and decision owner. Sounding sees only what you send. Optional means not required to submit, not unnecessary to assess. Preserve unknowns; never invent facts or authority. Takes no external action.

affected_people.description: Who is affected, including people not in the conversation.

alternatives.description: Other options considered, including doing nothing or a smaller step, each with one line on why it was set aside.

decision.description: The proposed action, options or question to assess. Use decision or the compatible proposed_action field.

evidence.description: Facts that support the action, one per item. Put facts against it in evidence_against.

evidence_against.description: Facts, risks and costs that count against the action, including side effects such as extra work, length or delay. Include them even if you still favor the action.

goal.description: The outcome you want to achieve.

prior_decisions.description: Earlier decisions, rules, definitions or standards in your project that bear on this choice, stated as they stand. Sounding cannot see your project.

proposed_action.description: Compatible alternative to decision. If both are supplied, they must match.

reversibility.description: How easily the action can be undone, and what cannot be undone.

urgency.description: Actual timing needs and their reason.

name: sounding_decision_check
